review_note: Both complete manus:A1.1-040 forms (24 short-answer items). Questions are shown in Vietnamese; learners answer from the English audio. The display switch does not change the existing English/Vietnamese equivalent-answer policy or the unscored self-review contract. No answer key, audio or scoring change; source-context pre-review is recorded; human perceptual listening was not performed.
